status_vocabulary.documented: value taken from a source attribute
status_vocabulary.derived: computed from a documented attribute with a stated rule
status_vocabulary.measured (DEM): sampled from a measured elevation model

checks.name: Campus terrain is not flat
checks.detail: Relief inside the boundary: 55.5–112.9 m (57.4 m), from 28746 DTM samples

checks.name: Local playing-surface grades
checks.detail: 5 playing surfaces use estimated local levels. Original in-field relief is 2.57, 5.47, 6.09, 6.5, 13.8 m. Slope and hillshade use the rendered grades at 2.5 m/pixel.

checks.name: Main Gate boulevard crossfall
checks.detail: The modeled carriageway varies by at most 0.07 m across 8.8 m, with 0.53 m of centreline relief in the sampled corridor. Profile estimated from FABDEM and panoramas 5147–5148.

checks.name: DTM vs mapped peak elevations (OSM ele)
checks.detail: n=3; mean Δ -2.24 m, max |Δ| 3.54 m (매미산 156.1 vs 158.5 m, 아람산 146.3 vs 147.1 m, 독침산 105.5 vs 109.0 m). A 30 m DEM is expected to slightly underestimate summits.

checks.name: DTM vs DSM agreement on open sports fields
checks.detail: n=950 samples; median DSM−DTM +0.46 m, RMS 1.61 m. This is an internal consistency check only (FABDEM is derived from Copernicus).

checks.name: Vertical datum handled (EGM2008 → WGS84 ellipsoid)
checks.detail: N = 23.34–23.79 m over the terrain window (EGM2008 via PROJ (us_nga_egm08_25)); this is added to every DTM height before rendering

checks.name: DEM grid registration
checks.detail: GeoTIFF GTRasterTypeGeoKey=PixelIsPoint; pixel (0,0) centre = 127.0°E, 38.0°N; 1″ spacing honoured without resampling

checks.name: Building footprint overlaps
checks.detail: 0 overlapping footprint pairs (>1 m²) among 1105 buildings

checks.name: Buildings on sloping ground
checks.detail: 22 of 42 campus buildings span >4 m of DTM relief. Their bases are set to the lowest ground point minus 1.5 m, so the uphill side is embedded in the slope and nothing floats.

checks.name: Campus building heights
checks.detail: In campus: 1 documented, 0 derived from floor count, 41 estimated. Whole scene: {'documented': 161, 'estimated': 938, 'derived': 6}. OSM and the official KHU pages do not publish heights for most campus buildings.

checks.name: DSM−DTM as height estimator (rejected)
checks.detail: Compared with 160 OSM-documented heights in the context area, Copernicus DSM minus FABDEM underestimated heights by about 45 m (r≈0.1), so it was not used.

checks.name: Official campus-map buildings matched to footprints
checks.detail: 24/24 official building entries matched to OSM footprints; unmatched: none; matched but outside boundary: 0

checks.name: Campus buildings connected to the path network
checks.detail: 39/42 campus buildings lie within 30 m of a mapped road/footway (median 6.5 m)

checks.name: Campus building model coverage
checks.detail: 42/42 campus footprints use individual models. 14 small buildings use approximate aerial-based forms.

checks.name: Stylised Kyung Hee building appearance
checks.detail: Campus buildings use OpenStreetMap footprints and DTM ground. 23 buildings use photo-based façades in addition to the landmark models. Main gate: illustrative model on the footprint frame (59.24 × 5.54 m, opening 11.3 m from footprint vertices); its heights are estimated. Amphitheatre: 41 seating terraces sliced from the real DTM. None of this detail is surveyed.

checks.name: North orientation
checks.detail: All geometry is in geographic coordinates on the WGS84 globe, so north follows from the coordinates. There is no local rotation or scaling.

checks.name: Imagery ↔ footprint alignment
checks.detail: Checked visually in top-down screenshots (see docs/screenshots). Imagery comes from tile services; their offset relative to OSM is not quantified here.
